LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_Astrorig.label: astrorig
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_Astrorig.description: A specialized personal movement pack designed for rapid traversal in zero-gravity environments. Utilizing a contained oxygen supply for controlled thrust, it allows for long-distance, high-speed jumps in space. The pack's design eliminates movement penalties on space terrain, though the amount of long range jumps is limited by the oxygen supply.
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_Astrorig.verbs.0.label: jump
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_DisposableOxygenPack.label: disposable oxygen pack
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_DisposableOxygenPack.descrip: A single-use utility pack containing a supply of compressed oxygen. When worn with vacuum-sealed apparel, it provides full immunity to vacuum by supplying breathable air until depleted. Once spent or unequipped, the seal is compromised and the pack is destroyed.
